decisions.decision: Final hold: actual neutral paradigm/page5 information names neither outcome nor contrast among choice-check, premeasure, nondissonance and attitude-change tests. No presumed focal endpoint, no numeric selection, no shared p-bound transfer. No further probe.

Confirm Carter/Gilovich Study3A PersonE versus PersonM 9-point comparative true-self insight item: explicit N121, reported one-sample midpoint-test Cohen d.371 and p<.001. Cost-response noncodability in footnote4 belongs to separate cost comparison; purchase satisfaction, dichotomized z test and gender moderation are not substituted.

Confirm Bryan Experiment3 official-turnout noun/verb comparison N214 matched voter records, likelihood-ratio delta chi-square1=4.91 and exact p=.027. Source explicitly says Census premanipulation voting-probability covariate unavailable in off-year Experiment3, distinguishing adjusted Experiment2. All214 matched retained; initial350/eligible293 and unmatched exclusions separate. Moderator tests do not redefine critical condition-effect model. Delta-chi-square retained in source evidence; existing parser recognizes the reference distribution, no metric conversion or inferential annotation.
